text: 金十数据9月30日讯，受进口增加影响，美国8月商品贸易逆差意外扩大。美国商务部周三公布的数据显示，商品贸易逆差较上月增长11.5%，达到1326亿美元，创下2025年初以来的最大缺口。此前对经济学家进行的调查显示，预估中值为逆差1150亿美元。上述数据未针对通胀进行调整。
text_en: Jinshi Data, September 30 - Affected by increased imports, the US August goods trade deficit unexpectedly widened. Data released by the US Department of Commerce on Wednesday showed that the goods trade deficit increased 11.5% from the previous month to USD 132.6 billion, the largest gap since early 2025. A previous survey of economists showed a median estimate of a USD 115 billion deficit. The data are not adjusted for inflation.
